Your computer is now configured to automatically lock after you leave. The settings have been configured as follows:

- **Blank Screen Delay**: 5 minutes (screen will turn off after 5 minutes of inactivity)
- **Automatic Screen Lock**: Enabled
- **Automatic Screen Lock Delay**: Screen Turns Off (locks immediately when screen blanks)
